description: Erection of detached single storey outbuilding to the rear of the house
decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of three years from the date of this permission.

Condition : 2 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted (Unnumbered Location Plan, Unnumbered Block Plan Received: 7 April 2021 WPPPE01 Received 17 May 2021) therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the building is used.

Condition : 3 - The outbuilding hereby permitted at the address 87 West Way, TW5 0JE shall not be used other than for purposes incidental to the occupation of the main dwelling and for the avoidance of doubt shall not be used as primary living accommodation such as a bedroom, bathroom, kitchen or living room or for business purposes.

Condition : 4 - Notwithstanding the provisions of the Town and Country Planning (general Permitted Development) (England) Order 2015 or any successor legislation, no access to the rear of the site shall be formed from the adjoining housing estate to the south.
